description: This file defines React components for the header view and global filter UI in a web-based test report interface, including navigation and filtering logic.

classes.name: HeaderView
classes.description: React functional component rendering the header with optional superheaders and title.

classes.name: GlobalFilterView
classes.description: React functional component providing a search filter UI with stats navigation.

classes.name: StatsNavView
classes.description: React component rendering navigation links for test stats filtering.

classes.name: NavLink
classes.description: React component for individual navigation link with count and icon.

methods.name: HeaderView
methods.description: Renders header layout with optional left and right superheaders and title.

methods.name: GlobalFilterView
methods.description: Handles filter text input and updates URL query parameters.

methods.name: StatsNavView
methods.description: Displays navigation options for different test result categories.

methods.name: NavLink
methods.description: Creates a link with count badge and icon for a specific test status.
